metas.name: With a Friend Like Harry...
metas.description: A vacationing family man meets an old schoolmate who decides to 'help' his life by any means necessary. A French thriller with a calm, smiling menace.

metas.name: Elena
metas.description: A quiet former nurse married to a wealthy man makes a calm, terrible decision for her own family. Zvyagintsev's precise moral thriller.

metas.name: Lake Mungo
metas.description: An Australian mock-documentary about a drowned girl whose grieving family keep finding her double in photos. A quiet, deeply unsettling puzzle.

metas.name: Wake in Fright
metas.description: A schoolteacher stranded in an outback mining town is swallowed by its friendly, drunken brutality. Ordinary men at their worst.

metas.name: Hatching
metas.description: A Finnish girl pressured by her perfectionist mother hatches a creature that becomes her monstrous double. Doppelgänger body horror.

metas.name: The Innocents
metas.description: Children on a Norwegian housing estate discover powers, and one uses them with escalating cruelty. A quiet film of real terror.

metas.name: Andhadhun
metas.description: A pianist who fakes blindness witnesses a murder he supposedly can't see. A darkly comic Indian thriller about a performance with deadly consequences.

metas.name: Nine Queens
metas.description: Two Buenos Aires con men chase one big score with a sheet of forged stamps. A slippery puzzle in which everyone is playing a role.

metas.name: The Servant
metas.description: A wealthy young Londoner's manservant slowly reverses their roles and takes control. A cold, insidious power-game drama.

metas.name: Knife in the Water
metas.description: A couple picks up a hitchhiker for a sailing weekend, and male rivalry turns dangerous. Polanski's tight three-hander debut.
